eval_params.eval_seed_note: LP and hop-regression were scored at embed time with the EMBEDDING seed (stored in config.json); rho, recall@10 and community use a FIXED eval seed 42.

link_prediction.held_out: NO -- the embedding saw every edge, so this is edge reconstruction, not held-out link prediction

hop_regression.feature: one scalar: euclidean distance in Z
hop_regression.pairs: 20000 from 200 BFS sources, min_hop 2, draw bfs_rows
hop_regression.reported_metric: hop R2 = random forest R2 on the test split

spearman_rho.definition: Spearman between euclidean Z-distance and hop distance
spearman_rho.pairs: 20000 from 200 BFS sources, min_hop 2 -- the SAME sample as hop_regression

recall_at_10.definition: share of a node's true neighbours among its 10 euclidean-nearest nodes
recall_at_10.knn: exact brute-force (all graphs are below RECON_MAX_N=200000)

community.clusters: k-means on Z, k = Louvain community count

eval_params.machine: 8 cores, 7 GB RAM, no GPU used
